title: Unformatted terminal RECEIVE: LENGTH in/out, LENGERR by RESP, by HANDLE CONDITION and by default, MAXLENGTH NOTRUNCATE pieces, SET; SEND CONTROL

scenarios.summary: RECEIVE INTO LENGTH(4) of an 8-byte rest with RESP: LENGERR, INTO gets the first 4 bytes, LENGTH the original 8
RECEIVE INTO with no LENGTH (INTO's 4 bytes) of a 7-byte rest under HANDLE CONDITION LENGERR: control goes to the label
the same RECEIVE with a 2-byte rest: NORMAL, the LENGERR label is not taken
LENGERR with neither RESP nor a handler: CICS's default action abends the task (AEIV)
MAXLENGTH(4) NOTRUNCATE in a loop: the rest comes back 4, 4 and 2 bytes, each NORMAL, nothing discarded
RECEIVE SET(ADDRESS OF LS-INPUT) MAXLENGTH(20): the LINKAGE record addresses the 7 bytes received
nothing left after the first RECEIVE; a second SEND CONTROL with CURSOR(85) ALARM FRSET ERASEAUP
